Sara —

Thanks for the clear scope. We can execute a scoped purge for CLH-4921; a few operational notes and requests so we align on evidence types:

1) What we will remove:
   - Stored prompt inputs and generated outputs tied to the account identifier (application IDs / tokenized request ids)
   - Request/response logs from the serving runtime (request metadata, timestamps, routing)
   - KV cache entries and any temporary prefix caches for sessions explicitly mapped to the account

2) Timeline expectations:
   - Intake and ticket creation: within 24-72 hours after we receive authorization and the signed intake (we can accept your attached signed PDF).
   - Execution window: ops will perform coordinated deletes on compute caches and persistent stores; depending on shard rebalancing this can take 3–10 business days to complete.
   - Evidence package (manifest + hashes + execution logs): we aim to provide a signed PDF and an audit folder link within 7 business days post-execution; in some cases (cold-archived logs) retrieval+redaction may extend to 14 days.

3) Authorizations we need from you:
   - Confirmation of the account id and the list of sample request ids (you provided in the PDF — good).
   - Point of contact for signature acceptance (email + name). If you prefer, we can route a DocuSign with a standard intake/authorization form.

4) Evidence format: we provide a purge_manifest (CSV/PDF), runbook excerpt, time-stamped execution logs, and an S3/Drive link to the folder that contains the artifacts. Hashes will be SHA256.

I've opened an intake ticket internally (RH-2048) and looped in Marissa (ops) and Stephanie (security) to scope the execution plan. Marissa will post a proposed schedule.

If that works, please reply with one-line confirmation and preferred POC for signature.

Best —
Jordan Blake

Hi Sara / team —

Thanks Jordan. Picking up RH-2048. High-level execution plan below and attachments (erasure_runbook_v1.md, RH-Jira-RH-2048-intake.txt).

1) Intake validation (Day 0–1)
   - Verify account mapping to EU cluster (region: eu-west-1).
   - Validate sample request ids against request index (we will only delete items that map to CLH-4921).

2) Safe deletion steps (Day 2–6)
   - Mark records for deletion in write-through metadata store (writes a tombstone).
   - Run targeted background expunge job across object store shards (this job removes artifacts and updates manifest).
   - Sweep continuous KV/prefix caches: purge session caches and collect pre/post counts.
   - Verify no dependent artifacts remain (re-run index checks).

3) Evidence & manifest (Day 6–8)
   - Generate purge_manifest_YYYYMMDD.csv (will include SHA256 hashes of deleted blobs, object keys, and delete timestamps).
   - Package runbook excerpt and signed execution log.

4) Post-execution QA (Day 8–10)
   - Security review of manifest (Stephanie) and redact any fields needed for privacy.
   - Publish evidence to shared Drive and provide a signed PDF (purge_manifest_20261210.pdf).

Notes / constraints:
- Cold-archived logs (if any) require retrieval and billing approval; that may extend the timeline (up to +7 days).
- We will not delete aggregated analytics (non-reversible statistical aggregates) unless specifically requested and scoped.

Attachments referenced: erasure_runbook_v1.md (Markdown; runbook excerpt), RH-Jira-RH-2048-intake.txt (intake summary).

Proposed window: start execution on 2026-12-07 and target evidence delivery by 2026-12-15. If you need an accelerated window for auditors, we can prioritize cold-archive retrieval but will need written confirmation to proceed and acceptance of potential fees.

Marissa Cole
Senior Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
